description:
Activate Moonscarred Werewolf by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Moonscarred Werewolf.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Moonscarred Werewolf.
Repeat.

uses.name: Scorned Villager // Moonscarred Werewolf
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Moonscarred Werewolf and without summoning sickness
